events.continuity_hook: Leave the Phoenix trip with a feasible return, any required third hotel night, and updated rental-car timing recorded alongside the existing reservations.
events.interaction_goal: Compare the late Wednesday and Thursday-morning options using total cost and realistic door-to-airport timing, then rebook the return and extend the hotel only if needed.
events.scenario_brief: The Phoenix team has extended Wednesday's final meeting from 4:30 p.m. to 5:30 p.m., making Marcus's confirmed flight unreachable once the drive, rental-car return, and security time are included. His Monday outbound and first two hotel nights remain confirmed, while a late nonstop and a Thursday-morning departure with one additional hotel night are available.

events.continuity_hook: Carry the selected coastal base, preferred seven-night date window, and one alternate date pattern into detailed flight planning.
events.interaction_goal: Compare the two coastal areas for this specific family week and settle on a destination and date window without making reservations yet.
events.scenario_brief: Marcus and his husband are beginning plans for a seven-night family vacation during their son's late-June school break. They are weighing San Diego against the Orange County coast for three travelers, with one day available on either side of the core week, and need an initial comparison of flight access, lodging areas, beach time, and the effort required to reach family attractions.

events.continuity_hook: Retain the strongest outbound and return pairing, plus one nearby-date fallback, while lodging costs are investigated.
events.interaction_goal: Narrow the flight search to one primary itinerary and one fallback after comparing total airfare, trip duration, and the lodging impact of each date pattern.
events.scenario_brief: The family has selected San Diego and can depart Chicago either Friday evening after Marcus finishes work or Saturday morning, returning the following Saturday or Sunday. They need to compare four practical round-trip combinations for three travelers, accounting for actual vacation time, the extra lodging night created by Friday travel, and arrival home before Monday commitments.

events.continuity_hook: Carry two lodging finalists with verified occupancy, complete totals, room configurations, and cancellation dates into the family decision.
events.interaction_goal: Compare suitable rooms in the two areas on complete cost and logistics, then identify a primary property and a credible alternative.
events.scenario_brief: The primary flight itinerary would give the family eight nights in San Diego. Marcus is comparing stays in Mission Bay and Coronado, and needs rooms that explicitly accommodate two adults and a 12-year-old rather than relying on a standard two-person listing. Resort fees, parking, taxes, cancellation deadlines, and travel time to planned beach and zoo days must be included in the full-stay comparison.

events.continuity_hook: Leave the Mission Bay room either cleared for all three travelers with a complete total and deadline or removed from consideration in favor of the Coronado option.
events.interaction_goal: Resolve the room occupancy, mandatory-fee total, and cancellation timing before the family commits to the property.
events.scenario_brief: One Mission Bay finalist lists two queen beds but shows conflicting occupancy details between the room description and the final reservation screen. Marcus needs confirmation that all three family members can be named on the booking and that the quoted total includes the mandatory nightly resort fee; the property's cancellation deadline also needs to be stated in Chicago time.

events.continuity_hook: Keep the completed San Diego flight and hotel details together for later transportation planning and any airline schedule movement.
events.interaction_goal: Verify dates and all three travelers, confirm the final airfare and lodging totals and terms, and complete the flight and hotel reservations.
events.scenario_brief: The Mission Bay room has been confirmed for two adults and one child, and the family has chosen it over the Coronado alternative. The primary flights still have three seats, but the airfare now carries a same-day purchase deadline, so traveler details, eight-night hotel dates, full totals, and cancellation terms need to be reconciled before both reservations are completed.
